title: music.library_event v1
description: A music-library state change, such as saving a track or adding it to a playlist. Item IDs are deterministic: ULID time bits from the envelope ts, random bits from the first 80 bits of sha256('provider|event|ts|track.providerUri'), so re-observation and re-import are idempotent.

event.description: Open-world event kind. Core vocabulary: saved, unsaved, playlist-added, playlist-removed.

provider.description: Open-world provider slug, e.g. spotify, lastfm, apple-music, local.

track.description: Snapshot of the track as observed. No item pointer is stored: the referenced music.track item's ID is derived from provider|providerUri.

purpose.description: Open-world playlist purpose, e.g. monthly-liked, user, imported.

observedAt.description: When Journey observed the event. Envelope ts should be the provider's event time when known.
